studio.heroTitle: Connecting meaning and purpose through innovation and design.
studio.philosophyBody1: Studio Logan creates lasting experiences through their narrative. Every decision: material, proportion, light, sequence. Deliberate storytelling through spaces where every element serves the story.
studio.philosophyBody2: The spaces that resonate are the spaces with something to say. We listen, we understand, we build a narrative that is honest to the context. Then we make it unforgettable.
studio.philosophyPrinciple: Listen. Understand the story. Build it with precision. Make it unforgettable.
studio.founderQuote: “We don’t design for aesthetics. We design for impact. Every narrative we build must change how people experience a space and how they remember it.”
studio.founderBio1: Yeswanth is a designer, storyteller, and former athlete who channels discipline and vision into creating spaces with purpose. Educated at the Pratt Institute, New York, he brings a globally-informed perspective to every project. He believes every project is an opportunity to craft a narrative that shapes human experience not just aesthetically, but emotionally and functionally.
studio.founderBio2: His award-winning work was recognized as Emerging Designer of the Year in Hospitality Design awards Las Vegas. His experience spans hospitality, commercial, and residential projects globally, all rooted in the conviction that design must have something to say. Context, culture, and intention drive every decision.
